meta.name: accessibility
meta.description: Audit and improve web accessibility following WCAG 2.2 guidelines. Use when asked to "improve accessibility", "a11y audit", "WCAG compliance", "screen reader support", "keyboard navigation", or "make accessible".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测并修复网页无障碍问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要让网站通过无障碍标准
copy.tagline_en: Audit and fix web accessibility issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make your website accessible and compliant.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 WCAG 2.2 标准审查并改进网页无障碍性。它检查图片 alt、颜色对比度、键盘操作、表单标签、ARIA 用法等，并给出具体代码示例、修复建议和手动测试清单。
howto.when: 当用户提出“改进无障碍性”“a11y 审计”“WCAG 合规”等要求，或要求支持屏幕阅读器、键盘导航时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个页面的无障碍问题
say.note: Claude 会按 WCAG 2.2 逐项检查并列出问题

say.text: 给这张图片写一段描述性 alt 文本
say.note: 它按文本替代原则给出 alt 属性示例

say.text: 检查表单的键盘操作和焦点可见性
say.note: 它按可操作原则审查 focus 样式和键盘陷阱

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude audits and improves web accessibility following WCAG 2.2. It checks image alt text, color contrast, keyboard navigation, form labels, ARIA usage, and provides code examples, fixes, and a manual testing checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "improve accessibility", "a11y audit", "WCAG compliance", or request screen reader support, keyboard navigation, or making content accessible.

say_en.text: Audit this page for accessibility issues.
say_en.note: Claude checks against WCAG 2.2 and lists problems.

say_en.text: Write a descriptive alt text for this image.
say_en.note: It gives an alt attribute example per text-alternative guidelines.

say_en.text: Check keyboard navigation and focus visibility on this form.
say_en.note: It reviews focus styles and keyboard traps under Operable.
